scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/tui run build && pnpm --dir packages/ai run build && pnpm --dir packages/agent run build && pnpm --dir packages/coding-agent run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && pnpm run check:pinned-deps && pnpm run check:ts-imports && pnpm run check:shrinkwrap && tsgo --noEmit && pnpm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.check:shrinkwrap: test -f packages/coding-agent/npm-shrinkwrap.json && echo 'npm-shrinkwrap.json retained for npm publish artifact'
scripts.version:patch: pnpm -r exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: pnpm -r exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: pnpm -r exec npm version major --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run check
